title: Fix admin registration authorization error and access denied issue

requirements.summary: Debug and fix the 'Access Denied' error that displays 'You do not have permission to access the admin dashboard' with 'Authorization Required' and 'Registration failed' messages when attempting to access the admin dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Access Denied' error no longer appears when authorized admin users attempt to access the admin dashboard
Admin authentication completes successfully for greenplantz2020@gmail.com and active team members
The error message 'Invalid record {name:text; role:text; businessName:opt text; email:text; phoneNumber:text}; argument field role' is resolved

file_operations.description: Fix the user profile data structure being sent to saveCallerUserProfile to match the backend UserProfile type exactly. Ensure the 'role' field uses the correct UserRole enum value (admin, customer, or vendor) instead of the authorization component's UserRole__1 enum (admin, user, guest). Add detailed console logging to capture the exact profile object being sent and any backend error responses during registration and authorization checks.

Add comprehensive error handling and logging in the admin authorization check flow. Log the response from isCallerAdmin backend call, the current authentication state, and the user profile retrieval results. Ensure proper error boundaries catch authorization failures and display them clearly to help diagnose why authorized users are being denied access.

requirements.summary: Verify and fix the admin authorization check logic in ProtectedAdminRoute.tsx that incorrectly denies access to authorized admin users, ensuring it properly validates admin status from the backend isCallerAdmin function before rendering the AdminDashboard
acceptanceCriteria: ProtectedAdminRoute.tsx correctly identifies admin users based on backend authorization response
Authorized admins can successfully access the admin dashboard without encountering 'Access Denied' errors
Unauthorized users are properly blocked from accessing the admin dashboard with appropriate error messages

file_operations.description: Review and fix the authorization logic flow to properly handle the isCallerAdmin response. Ensure the component waits for both authentication and admin check to complete before making access decisions. Add proper loading states to prevent premature access denial. Verify that the error state handling correctly distinguishes between authentication failures, authorization failures, and other errors. Add console logs showing the exact sequence of checks and their results.

Add or enhance the useIsCallerAdmin query hook to include proper error handling, retry logic, and loading state management. Ensure the hook properly communicates backend failures versus authorization denials. Add detailed logging of the backend response to help diagnose authorization check failures.

requirements.summary: Add comprehensive error logging in AdminRegistration.tsx to capture the exact backend response and error details when the 'Registration failed' and 'Authorization Required' errors occur, helping identify the root cause of the authorization failure
acceptanceCriteria: Console logs display detailed error information when admin registration or authorization fails
Backend responses from getUser, createUser, and isCallerAdmin calls are logged with full error details
Error messages clearly indicate which step in the authentication flow is failing

file_operations.description: Add comprehensive console logging throughout the registration flow. Log: 1) The authentication state and identity before any backend calls, 2) The exact user profile object structure being sent to saveCallerUserProfile (including all fields and their types), 3) The full error response from saveCallerUserProfile if it fails (including error message, stack trace if available, and any validation errors), 4) The response from getCallerUserProfile after saving, 5) The response from isCallerAdmin including whether it returns true/false or throws an error, 6) Any caught exceptions with full error details. Wrap each backend call in try-catch blocks with detailed logging in both success and error cases. Use console.group() to organize related log statements for easier debugging.

Enhance the saveCallerUserProfile mutation and useIsCallerAdmin query with additional error logging. Log the raw error object from backend calls, the error message, and any additional error properties. For saveCallerUserProfile, log the profile object being sent before the mutation executes. Add logging that captures whether errors are coming from network failures, backend traps, or validation failures.
